시편 129:1.content: A Song of degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

시편 129:2.content: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

시편 129:3.content: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

시편 129:4.content: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

시편 129:5.content: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

시편 129:6.content: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

시편 129:7.content: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

시편 129:8.content: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.
